collection.title: Abarth Grande Punto 2007 to 2010 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Abarth Grande Punto 2007 to 2010 model which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 15" for the passengers side. This model uses the Pinch Tab attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
